thinking:
Family-run restaurant in Hangzhou (家味餐厅 - Jiawei Restaurant) serving Zhejiang cuisine.
Local families, office workers, tourists.
Home page, Menu page, About page, Reservation page.
Professional, inviting, encouraging visits/bookings.
Simplified Chinese.
Static site, no remote dependencies, relative links, desktop-first (1440px) but responsive, no AI mentions.

    *   *Home Page:* Welcome message, highlights of the cuisine, call to action (Book Now/View Menu), beautiful imagery (via CSS/placeholder colors as I can't use external images, but I'll describe the visual style).
    *   *Menu Page:* Categories (Appetizers, Main Courses, Seasonal Specialties, Desserts), specific Zhejiang dishes (West Lake Vinegar Fish, Longjing Shrimp, etc.), and prices.
    *   *About Page:* Story of the family, heritage, commitment to fresh ingredients, philosophy.
    *   *Reservation Page:* Form (Name, Phone, Date, Time, Guests), contact info, address, map description.

    *   *Color Palette:* Warm tones (Cream, Gold, Deep Red or Forest Green) to reflect traditional Chinese elegance and the nature of Zhejiang.
    *   *Typography:* Sans-serif for readability, perhaps a serif-style header for elegance.
    *   *Layout:* Header (Logo + Nav), Hero section on Home, Grid for Menu, Simple form for Reservation, Footer with contact info.

    *   *Index.html:*
        *   Hero: "Taste the warmth of home in Hangzhou."
        *   Features: Local ingredients, Traditional recipes.
    *   *Menu.html:*
        *   West Lake Vinegar Fish (西湖醋鱼) - 88元
        *   Longjing Shrimp (龙井虾仁) - 98元
        *   Dongpo Pork (东坡肉) - 78元
        *   Zhejiang Braised Pork (浙江红烧肉) - 68元
        *   Tea-smoked Duck (茶烟鸭) - 88元
    *   *About.html:*
        *   Story: Started by Grandpa in the 80s, passed down to the daughter and son.
        *   Focus: "Freshness and Heart" (新鲜与匠心).
    *   *Reservation.html:*
        *   Form fields: 姓名, 电话, 日期, 时间, 人数.
        *   Location: Hangzhou, near West Lake.
